# Decisions

<!-- Generated from decision frontmatter. Do not edit by hand; regenerate on conflict. -->

## Proposed

- [Code style of the tools](repository/2026-11-20-tools-code-style.md): The code of the tools is formatted and linted by Biome, a pinned devDependency run in `npm run check`: four-space indentation, lines up to 120 characters, the recommended lint rules.

## Accepted

- [Agent contract](agents/2026-10-28-agent-contract.md): The core of the contract (the brain binds, decision before the work, open decisions are resolved by a person), extended with language, conflicts, content and work in a code repository. (2026-10-28)
- [Independence from the AI tool](agents/2026-10-28-ai-tool-independence.md): One contract and adapters from one source (instruction files, context package, plugins and skills). (2026-10-28)
- [The budget of `apply: always` rules](agents/2026-10-28-always-rules-budget.md): The title and the "Decision" section of a rule with `apply: always` go into the managed block; the budget is at most 10 such rules in the effective set and at most 150 words of content each. (2026-10-28)
- [The scope of rules for the agent: the `apply` field](agents/2026-10-28-apply-scope-for-agent-rules.md): The apply field (always, a glob or none) says when a decision goes into the agent's context; the effective set is the rules of the brain, limited by the budget. (2026-10-28)
- [The brain is not a data lake](model/2026-10-28-brain-is-not-a-data-lake.md): The brain contains only markdown documents with knowledge, decisions and the plan; raw material (transcripts, emails, PDFs, contracts, images) stays at its source, and the brain gets the result with a link; `lint` reports other files as a warning. (2026-11-01)
- [Core conventions](model/2026-10-28-conventions.md): One topic per file, splitting over a few hundred lines, every document in the index, file names in English in kebab-case, dates YYYY-MM-DD. (2026-10-28)
- [Core document kinds](model/2026-10-28-core-documents.md): The index and decisions are mandatory; the roadmap, risks, areas and steps are optional; a step has a fixed structure. (2026-10-28)
- [A free layout of the `decisions/` directory](model/2026-10-28-decision-area-subdirectories.md): The layout of the `decisions/` directory is free (flat, by domain, by year or a hybrid); decisions are detected by the file name, and the ID is unique in the brain. (2026-10-28)
- [Decisions as ADRs, a generated list](model/2026-10-28-decisions-as-adr.md): Every decision is a separate ADR file in `decisions/` with an ID from the date and a slug; the list is generated from the frontmatter, and conflicts are resolved by regeneration or by the agent. (2026-10-28)
- [Decisions extracted from conversations](agents/2026-10-28-decisions-extracted-from-conversations.md): A decision extracted from a conversation or another source outside the brain (a transcript, a chat, an email) always goes into the brain as `proposed`, with its source; `accepted` only on the explicit instruction of the person who decides. (2026-11-01)
- [Required minimal frontmatter in documents](model/2026-10-28-document-frontmatter.md): Every document of the brain has `description` in its frontmatter; a step also has `status`. The agent and tools scan the descriptions without reading the content. (2026-10-28)
- [Dogfooding](repository/2026-10-28-dogfooding.md): The dotbrain repository is the first user of the framework: every change of a convention also changes its own brain in the same change. (2026-10-28)
- [The language of dotbrain documents at publication](repository/2026-10-28-dotbrain-docs-language-at-publication.md): Before publication, the brain and all documentation of dotbrain move to English, so that they are readable for contributors from around the world; the translation is a separate step. (2026-11-16)
- [Generated index](model/2026-10-28-generated-index-and-registry.md): The list of documents in the index of the brain is a block generated from description. (2026-10-28)
- [Instruction files with a managed block](agents/2026-10-28-instruction-files-managed-block.md): Instruction files for agents have a generated managed block; an instruction file is an adapter, not a source of truth, and its manual part contains only operational hints that do not contradict the brain. (2026-10-28)
- [A language-agnostic framework](model/2026-10-28-language-agnostic.md): Language is a property of the brain: every repository chooses the language of its brain, and the framework assumes none. (2026-10-28)
- [License](tooling/2026-10-28-license.md): The whole dotbrain repository, together with the specification and the templates, is under the MIT license. (2026-11-16)
- [Lifecycles of a decision and a step](model/2026-10-28-lifecycles.md): Decision: proposed → accepted or rejected, then possibly superseded; step: draft → agreed → in-progress → done. (2026-10-28)
- [The manifest of the brain in the frontmatter of the index](model/2026-10-28-manifest-in-index-frontmatter.md): A brain declares its data (name, language, specification version, owner, description) in the YAML frontmatter of its `README.md`, without a separate file. (2026-10-28)
- [Markdown in git, readable without tools](model/2026-10-28-markdown-in-git.md): The brain is markdown files with YAML frontmatter, readable and editable without tools; the brain lies in git, in the code repository. (2026-10-28)
- [The name dotbrain and the `.brain/` directory](model/2026-10-28-name-and-brain-directory.md): The project is called dotbrain, and the brain of a code repository lies in its `.brain/` directory. (2026-10-28)
- [An open format with tools](model/2026-10-28-open-format-with-tools.md): dotbrain is an open format with tools, not a product with a backend; the brain lies in git, in the code repository. (2026-10-28)
- [A heading map in the manifest, a skeleton only where needed](model/2026-10-28-section-map-in-manifest.md): Keys in YAML and a heading map in the manifest of the brain instead of language packs; a fixed skeleton only for decisions and steps, free knowledge areas; specification and templates in English. (2026-10-28)
- [The simplest thing that works](model/2026-10-28-simplest-thing-that-works.md): A brain in a code repository without tools is a full use of the framework; tools are optional and do not require rewriting the brain. (2026-10-28)
- [The specification version in the manifest, without migration from the beta version](model/2026-10-28-spec-version-without-beta-migration.md): The manifest of the brain has a spec field with the version of the specification, and the marker of the managed block the same version; no field means the beta version, from which the specification describes no migration. (2026-10-28)
- [Technology of the tools](tooling/2026-10-28-tooling-technology.md): The tools (CLI) are written in TypeScript run by Node.js, in one implementation. (2026-11-03)
- [Contradicting decisions until resolved](collaboration/2026-11-01-contradictory-decisions-until-resolved.md): When a decision accepted on a branch contradicts an accepted decision that reached the main branch first, the branch merged second turns its decision back to `proposed` with both options before merging; until it is resolved, the decision from the main branch binds. (2026-11-02)
- [Conflicts in the log of a step and in generated views](collaboration/2026-11-01-step-log-and-view-conflicts.md): An entry in the log of a step is a list item with a date added at the end, and a conflict in the log is resolved mechanically, keeping the entries of both sides in date order; generated views unchanged, regeneration on conflict. (2026-11-01)
- [Step numbers on parallel branches](collaboration/2026-11-01-step-numbers-on-parallel-branches.md): The number of a step stays unique in the brain; when two branches take the same number, the branch merged second changes the number of its step and the links to it before merging. (2026-11-01)
- [Who works on a step](collaboration/2026-11-01-who-works-on-a-step.md): A step has an optional `assignee` field with the identities of people, written together with the `in-progress` status in the first commit of the work branch; it records who worked, and does not reserve the step before merging. (2026-11-01)
- [The brain in the same PR as the work](repository/2026-11-03-brain-in-the-same-pr.md): In the dotbrain repository, changes to `.brain/` go in the same PR as the specification, templates and other files that follow from them, in any of its commits, also in the same commit as the work. (2026-11-03)
- [Review of changes against the brain](agents/2026-11-03-brain-review-procedure.md): The review of changes against the brain is a core procedure done before closing a step and merging a branch, in Claude Code as a subagent from the starter template; the mechanical checks are enforced by a hook. (2026-11-03)
- [The scope of the change in the review against the brain](agents/2026-11-03-brain-review-scope.md): The review against the brain reads the change from the point where the branch left the main branch, with uncommitted changes; a change without its own branch is given as a range of commits by whoever asks for the review. (2026-11-03)
- [The brain with the work in any commit](setup/2026-11-03-brain-with-the-work-in-any-commit.md): The starter template by default puts changes to the brain in the same PR as the work, in any of its commits, also in the same commit as the work; apart from a step's `agreed` before the work on it and a separate commit per stage, the order of commits is neither a rule nor a subject of review. (2026-11-03)
- [Changes without a step](collaboration/2026-11-03-changes-without-a-step.md): A change that wholly carries out accepted decisions does not require a step; the review against the brain checks it against the Consequences of those decisions. (2026-11-03)
- [Plan mode in Claude Code when working on a step](agents/2026-11-03-claude-code-plan-mode.md): In Claude Code, writing a step and carrying it out start in plan mode, and after the plan is accepted they go on in auto mode; the agent turns plan mode on by itself according to a line in the block of `CLAUDE.md`. (2026-11-03)
- [Rules with a glob for Claude Code in `.claude/rules/`](agents/2026-11-03-claude-code-rules-directory.md): Rules with a glob for Claude Code are generated into `.claude/rules/<brain>-<name>.md` with a `paths` field, instead of into a `CLAUDE.md` in the base directory of the glob. (2026-11-03)
- [The conformance suite](tooling/2026-11-03-conformance-suite.md): The conformance suite is part of the specification in `spec/conformance/`; every case is one txtar file with a repository tree and the expected violations, and pairs (rule ID, path) are compared. (2026-11-03)
- [Decision subdirectories from the setup of the brain](setup/2026-11-03-decision-domains-from-setup.md): The starter template puts decisions in subdirectories by domain from the start, created together with the first decision in the domain; the first decisions go to `decisions/process/`. (2026-11-03)
- [The decisions of this brain in subdirectories by domain](repository/2026-11-03-decisions-by-domain.md): The decisions of this brain are in subdirectories by domain: `model/`, `agents/`, `collaboration/`, `setup/`, `tooling/` and `repository/`. (2026-11-03)
- [Editorial changes](collaboration/2026-11-03-editorial-changes.md): An editorial change that does not change the meaning of a document (a link, a typo, wording, formatting) is allowed without a step and without a decision; the review checks only that the meaning has not changed. (2026-11-03)
- [The role of `init`: a wizard of the skeleton, finished by the agent](tooling/2026-11-03-init-skeleton-for-agent.md): `init` is a wizard that collects answers question by question and builds from them a valid skeleton of a brain with a setup instruction; the rest (translation, code scan, architecture draft, decisions from the code) is done by the agent. (2026-11-03)
- [The plan of a step first, then the work](collaboration/2026-11-03-plan-before-work.md): Work on a new step is first only the plan in `steps/` with `status: draft`, and the work only on a separate instruction, once a person sets the step to `agreed`; the step and the work may go in one PR. (2026-11-03)
- [Review before committing directly to the main branch](agents/2026-11-03-review-before-committing-to-main.md): The review against the brain is required also before committing directly to the main branch, so changes without their own branch do not skip the review. (2026-11-03)
- [Step size and stages](collaboration/2026-11-03-step-stages.md): A step is one result to be agreed as a whole: a giant step is split into several steps, and a large one has a `stages` section and is carried out in stages, each of which leaves a working state, has an entry in the log and a separate commit in git; the plan and the work of a step are not called stages. (2026-11-03)
- [The status of a step visible in the content](model/2026-11-03-step-status-in-body.md): The status and `assignee` of a step are visible in the content: a status line generated from the frontmatter under the title of the step and the status next to steps in the index block; the frontmatter stays the source. (2026-11-03)
- [dotbrain only in a code repository](model/2026-11-05-code-repository-only.md): dotbrain works only in a code repository: one brain in `.brain/`, without permissions in the manifest; git, the `architecture/` area, the agent contract and the review against the brain are part of the core, and the only starter template is setting up a brain in a repository. (2026-11-05)
- [Steps named by the key of a ticket](model/2026-11-05-step-ids-from-tracker.md): Instead of a number, a step may have in its file name the key of its ticket from the tracker in lowercase (`steps/rp-111-slug.md`); both forms are valid in one brain, and a brain may require keys with a decision with `apply: always`. (2026-11-05)
- [A lighter subagent of the review against the brain](agents/2026-11-06-lighter-brain-review.md): The review subagent in this repository runs on Sonnet, reads only the documents changed, linked from the change or containing concepts the change removes or renames, and does not run the checks the hook enforces. (2026-11-06)
- [Starter decisions from their own templates](setup/2026-11-11-starter-decisions-from-templates.md): Every decision the starter template writes has its own template to fill in without judgment: languages of the work (`languages.md`), order of work (`order-of-work.md` or `order-of-work-before.md`) and steps named by the keys of tickets (`step-ids.md`). (2026-11-11)
- [An agent with a person in the loop](model/2026-11-17-agent-with-a-person-in-the-loop.md): dotbrain is run through an agent with a person in the loop: a person reads and agrees steps and looks at a step again when it is carried out, reads the content of decisions and possibly the risks; for anything else the person asks the agent, which finds the answer in the brain. (2026-11-17)
- [The CLI keeps the generated views, or an agent without it](tooling/2026-11-17-cli-keeps-generated-views.md): Generated views and instruction files are kept by the `dotbrain` CLI, and without it by an agent following the specification; a person keeping them by hand is not a supported way of working, people still read and write documents by hand, and no feature of the framework requires the CLI. (2026-11-17)
- [The core of the contract in the block, the work on the brain in a rule file](agents/2026-11-17-contract-core-and-brain-rules.md): The compact form of the contract has two parts: the core, in the managed block of every root instruction file, and the work on the brain, in a rule file of the brain read when the agent works in the brain directory (`.claude/rules/<brain>.md`, `.github/instructions/<brain>.instructions.md`, `<brain-path>/AGENTS.md`). (2026-11-17)
- [The dotbrain brain in English](repository/2026-11-17-dotbrain-docs-in-english.md): The brain and documentation of dotbrain in English, like the specification, contract, templates, code, file names, commits and PRs. (2026-11-17)
- [`dotbrain lint` before the end of work on the brain](agents/2026-11-17-lint-before-end-of-work.md): The agent runs `dotbrain lint` before ending work that changed the brain when the CLI is available (rule 23 of the contract, in the work on the brain); in Claude Code a `Stop` hook of the starter template enforces it with the exact version of the package. (2026-11-17)
- [The contract in the managed block always in English](agents/2026-11-17-managed-block-contract-in-english.md): In the managed block of every brain, the concise form of the contract, the tools' additions and the fixed words of the block are in English, and only the titles and texts of rules are in the language of the brain; the block is generated and compared in full. (2026-11-17)
- [The MVP gate without a second AI tool](agents/2026-11-17-mvp-gate-without-second-ai-tool.md): The Simplicity gate after the MVP does not require the same brain to work in two AI tools; in the MVP only Claude Code is checked live. (2026-11-17)
- [The MVP is version 1.0, without phases after it](repository/2026-11-17-mvp-is-1-0.md): The MVP is version 1.0 of dotbrain, released as the 1.0.0 package; the roadmap has no phases after the MVP, and `new`, `export`, the context package, plugins and skills are outside 1.0, without a plan. (2026-11-17)
- [No repository template on GitHub](tooling/2026-11-17-no-repository-template.md): dotbrain is published as the public repository `that-simple/dotbrain`, which documents the framework, without a repository template, and as the npm package `@that-simple/dotbrain` with the `dotbrain` command; no binary, plugins and skills outside 1.0. (2026-11-17)
- [The specification version in semver, first published as 1.0.0](model/2026-11-17-spec-version-in-semver.md): The specification has a version in semver (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`); the first published version is `1.0.0`, like the package, the versions may part later, and the specification describes the migration from the draft `0.1`. (2026-11-17)

## Superseded

- [Distribution channels](tooling/2026-10-28-distribution-channels.md): The framework comes out as a repository template on GitHub and the npm package `@that-simple/dotbrain` with the `dotbrain` command; no binary, plugins and skills outside 1.0. (2026-11-16) → [2026-11-17-no-repository-template](tooling/2026-11-17-no-repository-template.md)
- [The dotbrain brain in Polish](repository/2026-10-28-dotbrain-docs-in-polish.md): The brain and documentation of dotbrain in Polish; the specification, contract, templates, code, file names, commits and PRs in English. (2026-10-28) → [2026-11-17-dotbrain-docs-in-english](repository/2026-11-17-dotbrain-docs-in-english.md)
- [Optional tools](tooling/2026-10-28-tools-optional.md): No feature of the framework requires the CLI or other tools; what the tools do can be done by hand or by an agent according to the specification. (2026-10-28) → [2026-11-17-cli-keeps-generated-views](tooling/2026-11-17-cli-keeps-generated-views.md)
- [Checking translated managed blocks](agents/2026-11-03-translated-managed-blocks.md): In the managed block of a brain in a language other than English, `V-VIEWS` checks character by character only the parts that follow from the brain; the translated concise form of the contract, the tools' additions and the fixed words of the block are translated by the agent. (2026-11-03) → [2026-11-17-managed-block-contract-in-english](agents/2026-11-17-managed-block-contract-in-english.md)
